evidence: In the future, we, directly or through our third-party service providers, may develop or use information technology systems or software that incorporate artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities into our business.
AI algorithms and training methodologies may be flawed, ineffective or inadequate.
The rapid evolution of AI, particularly the anticipated government regulation of AI, could require significant resources for compliance.

AI development or deployment practices by us or third-party service providers could increase vulnerability to cybersecurity risks and require additional resources to implement heightened cybersecurity measures.
ai_positioning.summary: GTY adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, reconnaissant les risques potentiels liés à son développement futur (algorithmes défectueux, conformité réglementaire, vulnérabilités cybersécurité) sans démontrer d'engagement stratégique actuel.
